The '''Chandrila system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|planetary system]] and home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. It was located in [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] in the [[Ringali Shell]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CatCW" />
